stem: Several different processes can affect allele frequencies in populations.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Outline the processes that may affect allele frequencies in wildlife populations.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The process of selective breeding changes allele frequencies in a population. Plant breeders use selective breeding to improve crop plants such as maize.

Explain how selective breeding can be used to obtain a variety of maize where the plants are vigorous and of uniform height.
